name: BoxBrownie
shortDescription: Stitches 360 photos into a virtual tour of a property. No monthly price confirmed.
longDescription: BoxBrownie's virtual tour page says a tour is a 360 degree view of a property that a buyer can pan through. Its guide says you upload 360 photos, label each room, and get a shareable tour link. The pages we read did not list a monthly plan price. We did not upload a photo.
pricingNotes: The virtual tour pages we read did not list a monthly plan price.
bestFor: A 360 virtual tour a buyer can pan through
A property walkthrough built from 360 photos
notIdealFor: A vertical Instagram reel from ordinary listing photos
A confirmed monthly price from this listing
strength: The BoxBrownie virtual tour page says it stitches 360 photos into a walkthrough a buyer can pan through.
weakness: The pages we read did not list a monthly price, and the tour is a 360 viewer rather than a social reel.
smokeTestNotes: Virtual tour page and listing guide fetched on 2026-10-19. No account was created.

useCaseFit.listing-videos: Builds a virtual tour of the home from 360 photos.
